decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the Big Block FAQ attribute and updates ticket, pool-funding, reward, allocation, and fiat-buyer copy to describe only the remaining Small Block mechanism and the $5/$5/$5 mint split.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already replaces the mission-page prize-pool description with the remaining Small Block pool and never-ending $500 prizes; no stale Big Block content remains.
Removing Big Blocks and changing mint revenue allocation does not change the Transak provider, fiat-to-USDC conversion flow, supported payment methods, or deferred lifecycle state.

The revenue reallocation and Big Block removal do not change fiat-wallet creation, custody, seed-phrase requirements, stored assets, or buyer access paths; the generic ability to hold prizes remains valid.
The source decision does not change whether tipping is enabled, its mint-page placement, preset amounts, or custom-tip support.
